headlines.title: 新筑股份：拟发行股份及支付现金收购蜀道清洁能源60%股权，交易获四川省国资委批准

headlines.title_en: Xinzhu Co.: Plans to acquire 60% equity of Shudao Clean Energy via share issuance and cash payment; deal approved by Sichuan SASAC
headlines.summary_en: Xinzhu Corporation announced that the company plans to issue shares and pay cash to Shudao Group to acquire a 60% equity interest in Shudao Clean Energy, and at the same time sell 100% equity interests in Chuanfa Maglev and other assets, as well as 100% equity interests in Xinzhu Jiaoke and other assets, to Shudao Rail Transit Group and Sichuan Road & Bridge. The proposed consideration for the assets to be acquired is 5.603 billion yuan, and the proposed consideration for the assets to be sold is 1.455 billion yuan, with an issue price of 5.11 yuan per share and an issue size of 905 million shares. This transaction constitutes a related-party transaction and a major asset restructuring, but does not constitute a reverse takeover. It has been approved by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Sichuan Province and still requires approval by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and registration approval by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.

headlines.title: 河南成功发行政府债券560.04亿元
headlines.summary: 河南省在深圳成功发行政府债券560.04亿元。新增一般债券78.46亿元，用于基础设施项目建设。新增专项债券380.12亿元，其中：92.8亿元用于补充地方政府性基金财力；84.38亿元用于存量政府投资项目；202.94亿元用于土地储备、保障性安居工程、市政和产业园区基础设施和生态环保等重点领域的391个建设项目。再融资专项债券101.46亿元，用于置换存量隐性债务。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Henan successfully issued 56.004 billion yuan in government bonds
headlines.summary_en: Henan Province successfully issued 56.004 billion yuan of government bonds in Shenzhen. New general bonds totaled 7.846 billion yuan, used for infrastructure project construction. New special bonds totaled 38.012 billion yuan, of which 9.28 billion yuan was used to replenish local government fund financial resources; 8.438 billion yuan was used for existing government investment projects; and 20.294 billion yuan was used for 391 construction projects in key areas such as land reserve, affordable housing projects, municipal and industrial park infrastructure, and ecological environmental protection. Refinancing special bonds totaled 10.146 billion yuan, used to replace existing hidden debt. (Jiemian)

headlines.title_en: Global news you need to know before Wednesday's U.S. stock market open
headlines.summary_en: US stock index futures were flat on Wednesday, oil prices rebounded 1% during the day, and spot gold fell below 4,300. Big short Michael Burry increased his short bets against Micron and Nebius, based on the logic that "memory supply is surging, and prices will face downward pressure." The world's largest data center financing encountered obstacles, SoftBank's SB Energy IPO was postponed, and its $50 billion valuation was questioned. SoftBank launched a high-yield bond issuance of more than $11 billion to raise funds for AI expansion. Quantum computing company IonQ surged 12% premarket after the company demonstrated the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder. Alibaba Cloud will add data centers in 8 countries and regions over the next year. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series was officially released: starting at 5,999 yuan. Japanese stocks were closed today, the Shanghai Composite Index closed down 0.39%, and the Hang Seng Index closed down 1.01%.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology: Accelerate the intelligent upgrade of information and communication networks and industries
headlines.summary_en: Yu Xiaohui, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said on the 23rd at the opening ceremony of the 2026 China International Information and Communication Exhibition that it is necessary to actively promote the integrated innovation of artificial intelligence and information and communication, proactively assess and actively respond to the transformative impact of artificial intelligence on the information and communication network system, and accelerate the intelligent upgrading of information and communication networks and the industry. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 中科曙光在河北达成系列战略合作
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月23日讯，据中科曙光公众号，9月23日，在河北召开的2026中国国际数字经济博览会期间，中科曙光与当地政务部门、龙头企业、行业学会及高校签署系列战略合作协议，推动国产算力供给与区域数据产业、工业应用和人才培养深度融合的长期布局。

headlines.title_en: Sugon reaches a series of strategic cooperations in Hebei
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 23 - According to the Zhongke曙光 official account, on September 23, during the 2026 China International Digital Economy Expo held in Hebei, Zhongke曙光 signed a series of strategic cooperation agreements with local government departments, leading enterprises, industry associations, and universities, promoting a long-term layout for deep integration of domestic computing power supply with regional data industry, industrial applications, and talent cultivation.

headlines.title: 中铝集团与中国电子签署战略合作协议
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月23日讯，9月23日，中铝集团与中国电子在北京签署战略合作协议。根据协议，双方将在人工智能与高质量数据集、自主安全软硬件、工业控制系统、数字化基础设施、网络安全等方面深化合作。

headlines.title_en: Chinalco and China Electronics sign a strategic cooperation agreement
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 23 - On September 23, Chinalco Group and China Electronics signed a strategic cooperation agreement in Beijing. According to the agreement, the two sides will deepen cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence and high-quality datasets, independently secure software and hardware, industrial control systems, digital infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
